purpose: Conservative remediation baseline. This file does not upgrade any source-ledger status.
rules: A ledger status, path, product name or shared test file is not behavior evidence.
A substantiated row needs a resolvable test node that drives requirement-specific behavior and checks a failure path or invariant.
Live/provider/distributed claims additionally need a reproducible acceptance artifact from that system.
Counts move only when the row-specific evidence is attached and independently resolvable.
